# A WolOS older than libwol 1.15: Share and Trash are unavailable, Open With opens with the default app.
file report.pdf
wold share.file {"ok":false,"code":"invalid-argument","message":"The request is not a known call."}
wold file.trash {"ok":false,"code":"invalid-argument","message":"The request is not a known call."}
wold open.with {"ok":false,"code":"invalid-argument","message":"The request is not a known call."}
opener ok
